audience: Bangladesh nationals travelling to India for medical treatment

currentAdvisory.title: Limited urgent medical visa appointment slots
currentAdvisory.text: IVAC Bangladesh currently states that Dhaka, Chittagong, Rajshahi, Sylhet and Khulna are offering limited appointment slots for urgent medical and other emergency visa cases. Check the live IVAC notice before planning travel.

visaTypes.label: Medical Visa — Patient
visaTypes.description: For a patient travelling to India for medical treatment.

visaTypes.label: Medical Attendant — Attendant
visaTypes.description: For a medical attendant accompanying the patient.

visaTypes.label: Medical Visa — AYUSH
visaTypes.description: For treatment under Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha or Homeopathy.

visaTypes.label: Medical Attendant — AYUSH
visaTypes.description: Attendant for an M3 medical patient.

process.title: Get Indian hospital appointment
process.text: Obtain an appointment/admission letter from the designated Indian hospital. It should identify the patient and, where applicable, the attendant.

process.title: Apply online
process.text: Complete the official Bangladesh-to-India online visa application and keep the web file/reference number.

process.title: Book IVAC appointment & pay service charge
process.text: Use the IVAC appointment system, subject to slot availability and current advisories.

process.title: Submit documents at IVAC
process.text: Submit passport, printed application and category-specific documents at the selected IVAC.

process.title: Collect passport & verify visa details
process.text: Check the designated hospital, visa category, validity and entries before travel.

patientChecklist.label: Original passport with at least 6 months validity and 2 blank pages
Recent 2×2 colour photo with white background
Bangladesh NID or Birth Certificate, as applicable
Proof of residence required by current IVAC checklist
Proof of financial soundness as required by current IVAC checklist
Proof of profession / student / retirement status, as applicable
Medical documents and reports from Bangladesh
Valid appointment letter from the designated Indian hospital
Photocopies / printouts of application and supporting documents

important: The High Commission / IVAC may request additional documents.
The designated hospital on a medical visa matters; changing hospital may require FRRO permission.
Do not pay agents for 'guaranteed' appointment slots.
Check current appointment availability before booking non-refundable travel.

fees.governmentVisaFeeForBangladeshiNationals: No Government of India visa fee under the current policy stated by IVAC Bangladesh.
fees.ivacProcessingFee: BDT 1,500 all-inclusive service charge, effective 10 August 2025 according to the current IVAC notice.
